title: chant ledger output
description: What `chant ledger <table> --json` prints (#4363): the rows of one ledger on the local chant/lifecycle branch, filtered with typed filters instead of SQL. The tables and columns are the ones `chant query` loads (schema version 1 of its tables); a column chant query keeps as JSON text is an object or array here, and `signed` and `empty` are booleans. It reads the local branch and never fetches. Version 1 of the read contract. Readers ignore fields they do not know; a field is only ever added within a version. The codes are a closed list, each in the one closed list of `reason-codes.ts`.

result.description: The rows that every filter matched. Exit code 0.

table.description: The table read: resources and snapshots from each lexicon's snapshots, runs from the Op run ledgers, gates from _gates/, deploys from <env>/releases.jsonl, releases and cuts from _releases/, applies from _gates/<op>/applied.jsonl and pr_envs from _pr-envs/records.jsonl. applies and pr_envs were added within version 1 by #4551, read by chant 0.124.55 and newer. control_entries, from the control repo's _control/entries.jsonl, was added within version 1 by #4593, read by chant 0.124.55 and newer.

columns.description: The table's columns, in order. Every row has each of them.

at.description: The revision of chant/lifecycle read (--at), as given, or null for the branch tip.

where.description: Each --where clause, <field><op><value>, as given. Every one held for each row listed.

since.description: --since as the ISO instant it was read as, or null. The rows whose time column (observed_at, started or timestamp) is at or after it are listed.

total.description: Rows in the table before the filter.

malformed.description: Lines and files of this table that could not be read as their kind, left out of total and rows.

row.description: One row, keyed by column. Every row starts with member: the workspace member whose ledger it came from, or null outside a workspace. A value is a string, a number, a boolean, an object or array (a JSON column), or null. A runs row's root_member, added within version 1 by #4500, written by chant 0.124.54 and newer, is the member whose directory holds the terraform root a TerraformApplyOp run applied, or null when that is unknown (another kind of run, or a run whose Init step failed before it resolved the root, #4508; a failed terraform init still names it, #4512); a row from an older chant lacks it. A resources row's marker_stack, marker_env, engine_ownership and engine_owned_by, added within version 1 by #4534, written by chant 0.124.54 and newer, are the stack and env the resource's chant marker names and an ownership engine's verdict and what bound the node (never read for a decision), or null when unknown; a row from an older chant lacks them. A runs row's wave and a gates row's change_set and request, added within version 1 by #4551, read by chant 0.124.55 and newer, are the op wave job a run record is for, the stored change set a gate line cites and the gated request a pending fact asks for, or null.
